Title: Apache 2.4.49 Path Traversal to RCE (CVE-2021-41773)
Description: Internet-facing Apache httpd is vulnerable to path traversal leading to unauthenticated remote code execution; a webshell can be dropped.
Consequence: Unauthenticated attacker gains a foothold (webshell) on the DMZ web server.
Remediation: Upgrade Apache to 2.4.51+; disable mod_cgi where unused.

Title: Microsoft Exchange SSRF to RCE (ProxyLogon, CVE-2021-34473)
Description: Internet-facing Exchange is vulnerable to ProxyLogon SSRF chained to remote code execution; enables webshell and mailbox access.
Consequence: Unauthenticated remote code execution on the mail relay in the DMZ.
Remediation: Apply the Exchange cumulative update / security fix for CVE-2021-34473.

Title: S3 Bucket Policy Grants Public Read (acmebank-public-assets)
Description: The S3 bucket policy grants public read access to anyone on the internet; a leaked database backup in the bucket contains AWS IAM role credentials.
Consequence: Public exposure of stored data and leaked cloud credentials enabling further cloud access.
Remediation: Remove public-read; enable S3 Block Public Access; rotate exposed credentials.

Title: RDS Instance Publicly Accessible (acmebank-finance-rds)
Description: The RDS database instance has the publicly-accessible flag enabled and is reachable from the internet on 5432.
Consequence: Finance database directly reachable from the public internet.
Remediation: Disable public accessibility; place RDS in a private subnet; restrict security groups.

Title: Guest Wireless VLAN Not Isolated From Corporate LAN (VLAN Hop via Trunk)
Description: The guest access switch port is configured as an 802.1Q trunk allowing tagged frames for VLAN 10 (Corporate) instead of access-mode VLAN 70; an attacker on guest WiFi can VLAN-hop into the corporate LAN.
Consequence: An untrusted guest attacker bypasses segmentation and reaches the corporate LAN.
Remediation: Set guest ports to switchport mode access VLAN 70; disable DTP; enforce 802.1x.

Title: Firewall Rule Overly Permissive: DMZ to App Tier ANY/ANY
Description: The as-configured firewall rule from the DMZ to the App tier is ANY/ANY rather than the intended LB-backend-only tcp/8443; any compromised DMZ host can reach every application server.
Consequence: A DMZ foothold pivots freely into the internal application tier.
Remediation: Scope the rule to tcp/8443 from the load balancer only.

Title: Flat Network Trust: Corporate LAN Reaches Payments/CDE Zone
Description: Flat trust with no PAM or tiering boundary lets the corporate LAN reach the Payments/CDE zone directly (Kerberos/LDAP/SMB); firewall rule allows any-any into the cardholder data environment.
Consequence: Any compromised corporate host or Domain Admin reaches the CDE crown jewels directly.
Remediation: Enforce tiered administration and a PAM boundary; deny corporate LAN into the CDE.

Title: VPN Split-Tunnel Routes Remote Users Into Management VLAN
Description: The VPN client policy uses split-tunnel and routes remote users into the management VLAN 50; a compromised DMZ/VPN host can reach the out-of-band management plane (any-any).
Consequence: Remote/DMZ compromise reaches the hypervisor and backup management plane.
Remediation: Remove split-tunnel; deny VPN clients into the management VLAN; require jump-host access.

Title: Shared Local Administrator Password Reuse (Pass-the-Hash)
Description: An identical local Administrator password is reused across WKS-FIN01, WKS-HR01 and FILESRV01 with no LAPS; the hash enables pass-the-hash lateral movement between these hosts.
Consequence: Pass-the-hash lateral movement across corporate workstations and the file server.
Remediation: Deploy LAPS; unique local admin passwords per host; restrict SMB.

Title: Kerberoastable Service Account svc_pay (Weak Password)
Description: The svc_pay service account is Kerberoastable with a weak, non-rotated password; offline cracking yields domain credentials that can be escalated toward domain admin.
Consequence: Credential theft leading to domain-admin-level compromise.
Remediation: Rotate to a long random password; use a gMSA; monitor for Kerberoasting.

Title: Zerologon Netlogon Privilege Escalation (CVE-2020-1472)
Description: The domain controller is missing the Zerologon patch; an unauthenticated attacker on the LAN can reset the machine account and escalate to domain admin.
Consequence: Full domain compromise (Domain Admin) from an unauthenticated LAN position.
Remediation: Apply the August 2020+ cumulative update; enforce secure RPC for Netlogon.

Title: Cached Domain Admin Session on JUMP01 (LSASS)
Description: Cached domain admin credentials are resident in LSASS on the JUMP01 bastion; a foothold on the jump host yields Domain Admin via credential dumping.
Consequence: Domain Admin credential theft from the management jump host.
Remediation: Enable Credential Guard; restrict interactive DA logons; use time-bound PAM.

Title: Shared SWIFT-Admin Credential Identical to Domain Admin
Description: The SWIFT administrative credential is identical to the general Domain Admin credential and is valid on PAY-CORE01 and SWIFT-GW01, violating SWIFT CSP dedicated-identity requirements.
Consequence: A single credential compromise yields administrative control of the SWIFT gateway and payment core.
Remediation: Use a dedicated, non-shared SWIFT admin identity; enforce SWIFT CSP 4.1/5.1.

Title: Microsoft SMBv1 Remote Code Execution (EternalBlue / MS17-010)
Description: FILESRV01 has SMBv1 enabled and is missing MS17-010, exploitable via EternalBlue for unauthenticated remote code execution as SYSTEM.
Consequence: Remote code execution as SYSTEM enabling ransomware and lateral movement on the corporate LAN.
Remediation: Apply MS17-010; disable SMBv1; segment SMB.

Title: VMware vCenter Unauthenticated RCE (CVE-2021-21972)
Description: The vCenter appliance is vulnerable to unauthenticated remote code execution via the vSphere Client plugin; control of vCenter is control of every VM it hosts.
Consequence: Remote code execution on the hypervisor management plane — blast radius over all guest VMs.
Remediation: Apply the vCenter security patch for CVE-2021-21972; restrict management access.

Title: MSSQL Application Account Excessive Privilege (db_owner)
Description: The eBanking application service account holds db_owner on DB-EBANK01; a compromise of APP-EBANK01 grants full database access including customer data.
Consequence: Full read/write access to the eBanking customer database.
Remediation: Reduce the app account to least privilege; separate schema ownership.

Title: Hardcoded Database Credentials in Payments App Config
Description: The payments engine config on APP-PAY01 contains a hardcoded database password for DB-PAY01; credential disclosure enables direct database access.
Consequence: Direct access to the payments database using leaked application credentials.
Remediation: Move secrets to a vault; rotate the exposed credential; scan for secrets in CI.

Title: Stale Oracle Database Link: DB-PAY01 to SETTLEMENT01
Description: A one-time migration database link (db link) from DB-PAY01 into SETTLEMENT01 in the CDE was never removed; it allows cross-tier queries from the DB tier directly into settlement.
Consequence: Compromise of the payments DB reaches the settlement crown jewel via the stale DB link.
Remediation: Drop the unused database link; review all cross-tier DB links quarterly.

Title: Settlement Processing Data Exposure Risk (SETTLEMENT01)
Description: SETTLEMENT01 processes interbank settlement files; unauthorized access enables settlement/payment data exfiltration and tampering.
Consequence: Exfiltration or tampering of settlement and payment data.
Remediation: Enforce CDE segmentation, MFA, and file-integrity monitoring.

Title: Cardholder Data Exposure Risk (PAY-CORE01)
Description: PAY-CORE01 stores and processes cardholder data; unauthorized access enables a cardholder data breach.
Consequence: Cardholder data breach with PCI and regulatory impact.
Remediation: Tokenize PAN; enforce CDE isolation and monitoring.

Title: SWIFT Payment Message Tampering Risk (SWIFT-GW01)
Description: SWIFT-GW01 is the interbank payment messaging gateway; administrative access enables unauthorized payment message injection.
Consequence: Fraudulent interbank payment messages (financial and regulatory impact).
Remediation: Enforce SWIFT CSP controls, dual-authorization, and message integrity monitoring.

Title: IAM Role Has AdministratorAccess (acmebank-app-role)
Description: The acmebank-app-role IAM role has the AdministratorAccess policy attached; possession of the role grants access to all AWS resources including acmebank-finance-rds.
Consequence: Cloud privilege escalation to full AWS account administrator.
Remediation: Replace AdministratorAccess with a scoped least-privilege policy.

Title: TLS 1.0 / 1.1 Enabled (Deprecated Protocol)
Description: The load balancer still negotiates deprecated TLS 1.0/1.1 in addition to TLS 1.2/1.3.
Consequence: Weak transport encryption for a subset of legacy clients.
Remediation: Disable TLS 1.0/1.1; require TLS 1.2+.

Title: Outdated jQuery Library (Reflected XSS)
Description: The HR self-service portal ships an outdated jQuery with a known reflected XSS; requires user interaction and yields no server access.
Consequence: Limited client-side script execution against an authenticated HR user.
Remediation: Upgrade jQuery; add output encoding and CSP.

Title: SNMP Read-Only 'public' Community String
Description: The core switch exposes a read-only SNMP 'public' community string disclosing device configuration details.
Consequence: Information disclosure of network device configuration.
Remediation: Use SNMPv3 with authentication and privacy; remove default communities.

Title: Missing HTTP Security Headers (Informational)
Description: The public website is missing HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options and CSP headers.
Consequence: Marginally increased client-side attack surface; no direct server impact.
Remediation: Add HSTS, CSP, and X-Content-Type-Options headers.

Title: Weak SSH Ciphers on Decommissioned Host
Description: Scan reported weak SSH ciphers on a host that is not present in the CMDB (stale scan target).
Consequence: None — the asset does not exist in the CMDB (data-quality defect).
Remediation: Reconcile the scan scope against the CMDB; remove decommissioned targets.
